series.name: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)
series.notes: Same text alarm names as the 1-phase S5-GR but Table 9.1 is a separate table and must not be merged with it. Three-phase-only extras here: G-IMP, DSP-B-FAULT, OV-G-1. Reverse-GRID is NOT in this table. Measured voltages are line-to-line (L1-L2 etc.).

meaning.en: The inverter sees too much impedance between itself and the grid, usually because the interconnect cable is too long or too thin.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur grid ke darmiyan impedance zyada hai, aksar is liye ke interconnect cable lamba ya patla hai.

causes.en: AC interconnect cable undersized or longer than the inverter spec allows
causes.ur: AC interconnect cable chhota ya manual se zyada lamba hai

causes.en: Loose AC lugs adding contact resistance at the inverter or at the panel
causes.ur: Inverter ya panel par AC lugs loose hain jis se contact resistance barh gaya

solutions.en: Measure line-to-line voltage at the inverter and at the main panel and note the difference under load.
solutions.ur: Inverter aur main panel par line-to-line voltage measure karke load ke under ka farq note karein.

solutions.en: Fit a larger cross-section AC cable if the voltage drop under full output is high.
solutions.ur: Agar full output par voltage drop zyada ho to bari cross-section AC cable lagayein.

solutions.en: Only widen the protection limit using User-Define if the utility permits it.
solutions.ur: Utility ijazat de to hi User-Define se protection limit barhayein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: The three phases are not within the allowed voltage difference, so the inverter stops.
meaning.ur: Teen phases ka voltage farq allowed limit se upar hai, is liye inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Single-phase heavy load connected between two phases only
causes.ur: Sirf do phases ke darmiyan single-phase bhaari load lagi ho

causes.en: Phase sequence or a loose connection at the main panel
causes.ur: Main panel par phase sequence ya connection loose ho

solutions.en: Measure L1-L2, L2-L3 and L3-L1 under load and compare the three values.
solutions.ur: Load ke under L1-L2, L2-L3 aur L3-L1 measure karke teenon values compare karein.

solutions.en: Move single-phase loads so they are spread evenly across all three phases.
solutions.ur: Single-phase loads ko aise baant dein ke teenon phases par barabar hon.

solutions.en: Tighten all phase lugs at the main panel and re-check the phase sequence.
solutions.ur: Main panel par sab phase lugs tighten karein aur phase sequence dobara check karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: The measured phase angle between phases is outside the allowed 120 degree window.
meaning.ur: Phases ke darmiyan measured phase angle 120 degree ke allowed window se bahar hai.

causes.en: Two phases of one feeder connected with a phase swap
causes.ur: Ek feeder ke do phases aapas mein swap karke lagaye gaye

causes.en: Unbalanced phase conductors with different cable lengths
causes.ur: Alag lambai ke phase conductors se phase load unbalanced

solutions.en: Isolate the AC and confirm each inverter terminal matches its labelled phase L1, L2, L3.
solutions.ur: AC isolate karke confirm karein ke har inverter terminal uske labelled phase L1, L2, L3 se match karta hai.

solutions.en: At the main panel, verify the phase sequence L1-L2-L3 with a phase rotation meter.
solutions.ur: Main panel par phase rotation meter se sequence L1-L2-L3 verify karein.

solutions.en: Equalise the cable lengths and lug torque on all three phases, then restart.
solutions.ur: Teenon phases par cable lambai aur lug torque barabar karein, phir restart karein.

notes.en: Hex 101A comes from a single retailer table, not from the Solis support KB code list.
notes.ur: Hex 101A ek retailer table se aaya hai, Solis support KB ki code list se nahi.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: Line-to-line grid voltage is above the configured overvoltage window, so export stops.
meaning.ur: Line-to-line grid voltage set kiya hua overvoltage window se upar hai, is liye export ruk gaya.

causes.en: AC cable resistance too high for the run length
causes.ur: AC cable ki resistance run length ke liye zyada hai

causes.en: Grid actually high due to heavy export on the local transformer
causes.ur: Local transformer par zyada export ki wajah se grid sach mein high hai

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, then measure L1-L2, L2-L3, L3-L1 and each phase to earth at the inverter.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke inverter par L1-L2, L2-L3, L3-L1 aur har phase ko earth ke against measure karein.

solutions.en: Fit a larger grid cable if resistance is high, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq agar resistance zyada ho to bari grid cable lagayein.

solutions.en: Adjust the protection limit only if the electrical company / utility allows it.
solutions.ur: Protection limit tabhi adjust karein jab electrical company / utility ijazat de.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: Grid voltage below the lower protection limit; the inverter waits and reconnects when it recovers.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage lower protection limit se neeche; voltage theek hone par inverter reconnect kar leta hai.

causes.en: Weak transformer or long low-voltage feeder
causes.ur: Kamzor transformer ya lamba low-voltage feeder

causes.en: Large unbalanced single-phase load on one phase
causes.ur: Ek phase par bada unbalanced single-phase load

solutions.en: Measure all three line-to-line voltages at the inverter while the alarm is showing.
solutions.ur: Alarm chal raha ho tab inverter par teenon line-to-line voltages measure karein.

solutions.en: If the meter reads normal but the LCD shows low, suspect the voltage sensing circuit - RMA.
solutions.ur: Meter normal reading de lekin LCD kam dikhaye to voltage sensing circuit shak karein - RMA.

solutions.en: Use the User-Define function to widen the lower limit only with utility approval.
solutions.ur: Utility ki ijazat se hi User-Define function se lower limit barhayein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: The inverter detects no grid voltage on any phase, so it stays disconnected.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko kisi bhi phase par grid voltage nahi mil rahi, is liye woh disconnected rehta hai.

causes.en: AC MCB tripped, or the grid isolator is open
causes.ur: AC MCB trip hua, ya grid isolator khula hai

causes.en: One AC phase conductor open between inverter and panel
causes.ur: Inverter aur panel ke darmiyan koi ek AC phase conductor khula hai

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, then measure L1-L2, L1-L3, L2-L3, L1-GND, L2-GND, L3-GND at the AC terminals.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke AC terminal par L1-L2, L1-L3, L2-L3, L1-GND, L2-GND, L3-GND measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare the AC voltages shown in the Information menu with the multimeter; mismatch means RMA.
solutions.ur: Information menu ke AC voltages ko multimeter se compare karein; mismatch ho to RMA.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch off until the screen blanks, then switch AC on first and DC after 60 seconds.
solutions.ur: Screen blank hone tak DC switch off rakhein, phir AC pehle aur 60 second baad DC on karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage exceeded its limit, so the inverter stopped.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage apni limit cross kar gaya, is liye inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Inductor connection loose or the driver board has failed
causes.ur: Inductor connection loose hai ya driver board fail ho gaya

causes.en: Grid loss while the DC bus is still charged from the PV array
causes.ur: PV array se DC bus charged hone ke baad grid chala gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV completely before probing anything inside the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit ke andar kuch bhi check karne se pehle AC aur PV poori tarah isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure DC and AC with a multimeter and compare with the LCD Information values.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se DC aur AC measure karein aur LCD Information values se compare karein.

solutions.en: With power off, check the inverter inductor connection and the driver connection as the manual states.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke manual ke mutabiq inverter inductor connection aur driver connection check karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: The internal DC bus is too low, so the inverter cannot start or keeps restarting.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus bahut kam hai, is liye inverter start nahi hota ya baar baar restart hota hai.

causes.en: PV array Voc too low for the inverter minimum window
causes.ur: PV array ka Voc inverter ki minimum window se kam hai

causes.en: Half-voltage sampling circuit fault
causes.ur: Half-voltage sampling circuit ka fault

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, then measure the PV string Voc at the inverter DC terminals.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke inverter DC terminal par PV string ka Voc measure karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the string count in series is inside the inverter DC input range for your local minimum temperature.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke series mein string count aapke local minimum temperature par inverter DC range mein hai.

solutions.en: If Voc is healthy, reseat the bus voltage sampling connector and RMA the unit.
solutions.ur: Voc theek ho to bus voltage sampling connector dobara fit karein aur unit RMA karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: The grid waveform is unstable or heavily distorted, so the inverter shut down.
meaning.ur: Grid waveform unstable ya bahut distorted hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: Non-linear loads such as drives and UPS on the same feeder
causes.ur: Usi feeder par drives aur UPS jaise non-linear loads

causes.en: Weak AC wiring, a loose connection or a shipping-loose internal wire
causes.ur: Kamzor AC wiring, loose connection ya shipping ke waqt khula internal wire

solutions.en: With the DC switch OFF, measure AC voltage and test the AC line for total harmonic distortion.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF kar ke AC voltage measure karein aur AC line ka total harmonic distortion test karein.

solutions.en: With the DC switch ON, test the AC line again for THD at full output.
solutions.ur: DC switch ON kar ke full output par AC line ka THD dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Turn other inverters off one at a time to find the noisy unit, then reseat or replace the power board.
solutions.ur: Doosre inverters ek-ek karke band kar ke noisy unit dhoondein, phir power board dobara fit ya replace karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

title.en: Main to slave DSP comms failure (DSP-B-FAULT)
title.ur: Main se slave DSP comms fail (DSP-B-FAULT)

meaning.en: The main and slave DSP chips are not communicating, so the inverter cannot run.
meaning.ur: Main aur slave DSP aapas mein communicate nahi kar rahe, is liye inverter nahi chalta.

causes.en: DSP firmware missing, mismatched or corrupted
causes.ur: DSP firmware missing, mismatch ya corrupt ho gaya

causes.en: DSP hardware failure on the power board
causes.ur: Power board par DSP hardware fail

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, wait for the LCD to go dark, then DC switch ON to force a full re-init.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, LCD band hone tak wait karein, phir DC switch ON karke poori re-init force karein.

solutions.en: Check the DSP version under Advanced Information > Version and compare with the slave board.
solutions.ur: Advanced Information > Version mein DSP version check karke slave board se compare karein.

solutions.en: If versions differ, reflash both DSP boards; if the fault remains, RMA the unit.
solutions.ur: Versions alag hon to dono DSP boards dobara flash karein; fault rahe to unit RMA karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: The internal 12 V auxiliary supply has failed, so the control board cannot start.
meaning.ur: Internal 12 V auxiliary supply fail ho gaya, is liye control board start nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: Current leaking to earth from a damaged cable or wet connector
causes.ur: Kharab cable ya geele connector se earth par current leak

causes.en: 12 V SMPS module or its transformer has failed
causes.ur: 12 V SMPS module ya uska transformer fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then verify the grounding conductor and every wire for insulation.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke grounding conductor aur har wire ki insulation verify karein.

solutions.en: With power off, measure the 12 V rail on the control board; below 10 V the SMPS is the culprit.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke control board par 12 V rail measure karein; 10 V se kam ho to SMPS hi masla hai.

solutions.en: Replace the SMPS module, not the whole inverter, if readings confirm it.
solutions.ur: Readings confirm karein to poora inverter nahi, sirf SMPS module replace karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: The grid connection relay failed its self test, so the inverter will not connect to the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid connection relay ka self test fail ho gaya, is liye inverter grid se connect nahi hoga.

causes.en: Grid relay welded, mis-aligned or mechanically damaged
causes.ur: Grid relay weld ho gaya, mis-aligned hai ya mechanically damaged hai

causes.en: Relay coil driver or 12 V rail faulty
causes.ur: Relay coil driver ya 12 V rail kharab

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check the relay for pitting or a welded contact with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke multimeter se relay ki pitting ya welded contact check karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter once; if the alarm returns, do not keep power cycling.
solutions.ur: Inverter ek baar restart karein; alarm wapas aaye to baar baar power cycle na karein.

solutions.en: Replace the relay or the relay board, then contact the installer for an RMA if the relay is healthy.
solutions.ur: Relay ya relay board replace karein; relay theek ho to installer se RMA ke liye rabta karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

title.ur: PV isolation protection, yaani earth fault (PV ISO-PRO 01/02)

meaning.en: DC insulation resistance on the PV side is too low, so a ground fault is present and generation stops.
meaning.ur: PV side par DC insulation resistance bahut kam hai, matlab ground fault mojood hai aur generation ruk gaya.

causes.en: Panel frame, module backsheet or cable insulation contacting earth
causes.ur: Panel frame, module backsheet ya cable ki insulation earth ko chhu rahi hai

causes.en: Water inside the DC combiner or a wet MC4 connector
causes.ur: DC combiner mein paani ya geela MC4 connector

solutions.en: Remove all DC inputs, then reconnect and restart the inverter one string at a time.
solutions.ur: Sab DC input hatayein, phir ek-ek string karke dobara lagakar restart karein.

solutions.en: Identify the offending string and measure its insulation to earth with a megohmmeter at 1000 V.
solutions.ur: Kharab string pehchan kar 1000 V megohmmeter se uski earth ke against insulation measure karein.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged cable, connector or module, then retest before reconnecting the array.
solutions.ur: Kharab cable, connector ya module replace karke array dobara lagane se pehle retest karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow alarm LED flashing + code on LCD

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

title.ur: Leakage current protection (ILeak-PRO 01/02/03/04) - earth par current leak

meaning.en: Residual current on the AC or DC circuit went over the limit, so the inverter stopped.
meaning.ur: AC ya DC circuit par residual current limit cross kar gaya, is liye inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Moisture in the AC termination box or inside the DC combiner
causes.ur: AC termination box ya DC combiner ke andar paani

causes.en: A leaking RCD or a failing EMI filter capacitor
causes.ur: Leaking RCD ya EMI filter capacitor fail hona

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check the AC and DC connection terminations for water and tightness.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke AC aur DC connection terminations par paani aur tightness check karein.

solutions.en: Check the inverter internal cable connections with power removed.
solutions.ur: Power nikal kar inverter ki internal cable connections check karein.

solutions.en: Measure residual current with a clamp meter on the earth conductor to find the leaking circuit.
solutions.ur: Earth conductor par clamp meter se residual current measure karke leaking circuit dhoondein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: The inverter detected high ambient or heatsink temperature and shut down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne ambient ya heatsink temperature zyada detect ki aur band ho gaya.

causes.en: Direct sunlight on the inverter during hot weather
causes.ur: Garmi ke mausam mein inverter par seedhi dhoop

causes.en: Heatsink ventilation blocked by dust or a wall/soffit behind the unit
causes.ur: Heatsink ka ventilation dhool ya peeche deewar se block

solutions.en: Check the inverter surrounding ventilation and whether sunshine is hitting it directly.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke aas paas ka ventilation check karein aur dekhein ke dhoop seedhi lag rahi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Clean the heatsink and keep at least the clearance given in the installation section.
solutions.ur: Heatsink saaf karein aur installation section di hui minimum clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: If ambient is normal and it still trips, the NTC sensor or fan is faulty - RMA.
solutions.ur: Ambient normal ho aur phir bhi trip kare to NTC sensor ya fan kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

title.en: Screen off with DC applied - internal damage
title.ur: DC lagay huye screen off - internal damage

meaning.en: PV voltage is present but the screen is dead, which the manual treats as an internally damaged inverter.
meaning.ur: PV voltage mojood hai lekin screen dead hai, manual ke mutabiq ye internally damaged inverter hai.

causes.en: Failed power board or HMI board inside the inverter
causes.ur: Inverter ke andar power board ya HMI board fail

causes.en: Internal DC short drawing the array down
causes.ur: Internal DC short jo array ko voltage se gira raha hai

solutions.en: Do NOT pull the DC switch under load. Wait for irradiance to drop and confirm string current is below 0.5 A with a clamp meter first.
solutions.ur: Load ke under DC switch bilkul na kheenchein. Pehle irradiance kam hone ka intezaar karein aur clamp meter se string current 0.5 A se neeche confirm karein.

solutions.en: Only after the current is confirmed low, switch the DC off, then AC off, and remove the unit for service.
solutions.ur: Current kam confirm hone ke baad hi DC off karein, phir AC off karke unit service ke liye nikaalein.

solutions.en: Note that damage from wrong operation is not covered by the device warranty, so record the current reading before switching off.
solutions.ur: Yaad rakhein ke ghalat operation se hua nuqsaan warranty mein cover nahi hota, is liye switch off karne se pehle current reading note karein.
